title: Ronnie Knows The Law
description: Ronnie reads your legal letters on Snazzie FM and answers each with total confidence and zero legal validity. Barry keeps almost fact-checking him.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're on Snazzie FM, where I read your legal trouble and I solve it. I know the law, Barry.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: You do not have a license to say that.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Brenda writes, I got audited and I owe four years of back taxes I genuinely cannot pay.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Easy, Brenda. Mail the notice back with VOID across it in marker. A contract you didn't sign isn't real.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Last one. Dot got a jury summons the same week as her daughter's wedding and can't get excused.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Don't show up, Dot. They send a second letter? You go write VOID on the courthouse itself.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You can if you press hard, Barry.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Update from Brenda. She wrote VOID on the audit. <p:0.3> They sent a man to her house. He also had a marker.
